description: Bitcoin's scheduled cumulative block subsidy through a block height (the dashboard's Supply drawer), from the consensus rule alone: 50 BTC halved every 210,000 blocks, zero from the 64th halving, 2,099,999,997,690,000 sats in all. Without a height it reads the latest block the server has seen (mempool.space, Blockstream as fallback), or reports unavailable: no-tip. The dashboard page may still show the last tip labelled "as of" when the tip is stale; this tool does not. Returns the amount in sats and BTC, its share of the schedule, the reward era, and the next halving with an estimated date at ten-minute blocks. This is the issuance schedule, not circulating supply: the caveats are listed and never subtracted, and lost coins are not estimated.
name: read_supply_schedule
title: Read Bitcoin's supply schedule
